### Project Summary – MARS: REWIND & BEYOND

**MARS: REWIND & BEYOND** is an interactive space exploration experience designed to bring the journey of NASA's Spirit Rover to life.

At the heart of our project is an interactive timeline website that takes users through the complete Spirit Rover mission, showcasing its major milestones, technological developments, electronic connections and journey from Earth to Mars. It transforms complex space mission information into an engaging, visual and easy-to-understand learning experience.

To take exploration beyond the timeline, we also developed a 3D interactive Mars rover simulation game. Users can experience rover assembly, activation, launch, cruise, entry, descent and landing, followed by Martian surface exploration, image capture, virtual sample collection and data transmission back to Earth.

We further integrate electronics through an Arduino-based setup with a rotary encoder, connecting the digital experience with hands-on engineering.

By combining interactive storytelling, 3D simulation, electronics and space science, MARS: REWIND & BEYOND aims to make the remarkable journey of Mars exploration accessible, immersive and exciting for everyone.

Project Details – MARS: REWIND & BEYOND

MARS: REWIND & BEYOND is an interactive space exploration project that transforms the journey of NASA's Spirit Rover into an engaging, hands-on learning experience.

How It Works:
Our primary innovation is an interactive timeline website that allows users to travel through the Spirit Rover mission. Using a physical rotary encoder connected to an Arduino, users can turn clockwise to explore the future, anticlockwise to revisit the past, and return to zero to view the complete timeline. This connects physical interaction with digital storytelling.

To extend the experience, we developed a 3D Mars rover simulation where users can assemble and activate the rover, experience its launch and landing, explore the Martian surface, capture images, collect virtual soil and rock samples, and transmit simulated scientific data back to Earth.

Benefits and Intended Impact:
The project makes complex space missions easier to understand through interactive learning.. It encourages curiosity about space science, robotics, electronics and engineering while making STEM education more engaging and accessible. We did this in interactive way for one rover if we do the same for several rovers then we make a most effective and low cost museum

Tools and Technologies:
We used web development platforms, AI-assisted development tools, Arduino, a rotary encoder, breadboard, jumper wires and USB connectivity to combine software with physical hardware.

Creativity and Innovation:
Our creativity lies in combining an interactive physical timeline, digital storytelling and a 3D mission simulation into one connected space exploration experience. Instead of simply reading about a Mars mission, users can interact with its timeline and experience the rover's journey.

Factors Considered:
We considered user engagement, ease of navigation, educational value, realistic mission stages, hardware-software integration, accessibility and the feasibility of building an interactive prototype within our available time.

Our vision is to turn space exploration from something people simply observe into something they can actively experience.
